quotes.title: HD 233731
quotes.card: HD 233731, or HAT-P-22, is a suspected multiple star system in the northern circumpolar constellation of Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: It is invisible to the naked eye, having an apparent visual magnitude of 9.732.
